The structure of composition Nb6Co12C18 (reduced formula Nb(Co3C2)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1md (No. 143), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies carbon centers as octahedral, each surrounded by six Nb neighbors, while Nb centers show four- and five-coordinate carbon environments; Co centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by two C and two Nb neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between carbon octahedra, and corner-sharing between Co four-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 36 sites.
